verdict.rationale: Operating a payments platform through natural-language commands is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only AI-assisted integration aids: Agent Skills that give AI coding assistants integration guidance, an llms.txt file, and an integration prompt that generates code snippets. None of these lets a user run EBANX operations such as payments, refunds or payouts with natural-language commands, so they are adjacent developer aids and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
